Dishonored 2 Save File Location (Windows)

Dishonored 2 stores its save files at %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Arkane Studios\dishonored2\base\savegame on Windows. Checkpoint64 already knows this folder — it backs it up automatically and keeps every version, so a corrupted or overwritten save is one click from restored.

Where Dishonored 2 saves are stored

  • Windows — %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Arkane Studios\dishonored2\base\savegame

How to open the save folder

  • Windows — press Win+R, paste %USERPROFILE%\Saved Games\Arkane Studios\dishonored2\base\savegame, and press Enter.

Backing up Dishonored 2 saves automatically

  1. Install Checkpoint64 (free) and pick Dishonored 2 — the save path above is already preset.
  2. Auto-backup watches the folder and uploads a new version whenever it changes, keeping full history.
  3. Restore any version in one click if a save corrupts, gets overwritten, or a mod breaks it.
